sections.lede: We accept mods for any board game. Your mod will be reviewed by the team and, if approved, published to the library with full credit.

blocks.heading: What we look for
paragraphs: A clear base game (the original game your mod patches), playtest evidence (at least 3 sessions), a PDF rulebook or rules document, and player count, time estimate, and age rating.

blocks.heading: How to submit
paragraphs: Email your mod to submit@moddable.games with your rulebook attached. Include a one-paragraph description and your playtesting notes.
Alternatively, open a pull request on our rules repository with your rulebook in markdown format.
